review_comments.body: I really, *really* dislike single-letter names, especially in a codebase as large as this, and *especially* with a lot of mathematical operations.

> I really, _really_ dislike single-letter names, especially in a codebase as large as this, and _especially_ with a lot of mathematical operations.

I should comment that this is copied from `_datetimemodule.c`
P.S. The codebase in `_datetimemodule.c` and `_zoneinfo.c` are already a mess. If possible I could refactor them later in a new PR.
Oh, it's copied. In that case, it might be better to just add an API function to `datetime` and call it.

> Oh, it's copied. In that case, it might be better to just add an API function to `datetime` and call it.

Right now, these 2 modules have multiple almost-same temporal functions. They should have a reason to do so but I don't think here to add and call an API in `datetime` is clean enough.

We probably have only two "clean" choices here, while please notice that I'm not saying the current draft is the clean one, instead it is quite hacky, ugly and breaks `fold` property (= 0). I will leave the details at the original issue.
